text_block_list.text: (Whooosh... Whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: (To the south――a beach overlooking the ocean...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah, this is the perfect place to reset
and start fresh.
I'll make a new start from right here.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"This autumn, I will put even more focus on my running.
And the power of feng shui won't just be words—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: “—I'll show them through my own running! So they can believe from the bottom of their hearts, and to become the support for their true happiness!”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Rickey?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...So, I figured I'd cut back on media appearances a bit and focus on my running. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I told you so.
I told you we shouldn't take detours.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe it just goes to show how much she's capable of doing.
I don't think I could ever pull that off, though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I can only think about one thing: I want everyone to know
more about my beloved hometown, Tomakomai."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“Still... no matter how hard I tried with my local idol work back home,
I couldn't draw in any visitors at all.”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody paid any attention to me, and some people even said,
'Why bother with your hometown? Just be a normal idol.'"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: There were times when I thought it was impossible no matter how hard I tried, but still...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series was different.
If you run and win, everyone will take notice of you,
and you'll get the chance to make your mark.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I run. If I don't produce results
with my running first, none of it will come true."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just one step away from reaching the top class on dirt.
And winning as much as possible is for Tomakomai's sake.
That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm... going to run so much this autumn and winter!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"From the JBC Classic to the Champions Cup.
As many big races as possible!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickey is chasing from behind, but I have to catch up
to Acute-san up ahead too.
...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
I was just talking with Tarumae, and—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It might not be easy.
Catching up to Tarumae, that is.
choice_data_list: So, what did you talk about?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A talk about our feelings toward racing. Tarumae built hers up without hesitation.
Never taking detours, staying single-minded.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that really did hurt us a bit.
Spending way too much time on TV appearances and all.
Still—
choice_data_list: You're not gonna give up, are you?
You're not giving up, are you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We need to get back on track
from here, the two of us together. And then—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"At the Champions Cup,
I'll hit Tarumae with everything I've got!
Channeling all my feng shui power into my running!"
"The Classic Class Copano Rickey and the Senior Class Hokko Tarumae. The difference in skill might still be clear, but even so—"

Nothing changes if we don't take on the challenge.
Let us build up an unshakable foundation as best we can.
